internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across all three Quranic occurrences the root appears only as a perfect verb (طَفِقَا / طَفِقَ) that means the subject 'took up / set about' doing something. طفق itself never names the activity — the activity is supplied by whatever follows it: 'they set about STITCHING leaves over themselves' (7:22, 20:121) and 'he set about WIPING the legs and necks' (38:33). Because the very same طفق attaches to two different kinds of complement (a finite verb and a bare verbal noun) yet the constant contributed sense is only 'commenced/undertook,' its own content is aspectual (phase-onset), not lexical. The account is internally clean but rests on thin evidence: three tokens, of which 7:22 and 20:121 are a near-verbatim echo of one Adam episode, leaving effectively two independent contexts and only one verbal form (perfect).
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Does NOT denote any concrete physical act (the concrete verbs are خصف, مسح, not طفق); does NOT entail completion, result, or telicity (marks entry into an activity, never its accomplishment); does NOT govern a patient-object directly (objects route through the complement — even accusative مسحًا in 38:33 is the content/manner of the begun act, not a patient of طفق); carries NO moral coloring (neutral in the Adam lapse frame with وعصى/فغوى and in Solomon's frame alike); is NOT domain-bound (clothing-repair vs. handling animals); is NOT productive (frozen perfect only — no imperfect, imperative, participle, maṣdar, nominal, or derived form of طفق itself); and makes NO claim about non-perfective behavior (attested perfective only).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 38:33 (فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ) is the sole adversarial boundary: it is the only context outside the Adam/Eve narrative — i.e. the only genuinely independent data point — and it breaks the canonical 'طفق + finite imperfect' template by taking an accusative maṣdar complement (مسحًا) instead of a finite verb (contrast يخصفان). This changed construction keeps a live competing 'thin lexical verb' reading ('he applied himself to a wiping') available, so the class is not adversarially clean at the syntactic level. It does NOT, however, semantically break the account: 'he set about wiping' fits comfortably, so 38:33 caps strength and scope but does not overturn the inceptive nucleus.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: Two related competitors, neither Quran-internally defeasible on n=3: (1) durative/continuative 'kept on / persisted in doing' — grammatically available in 7:22/20:121 where يخصفان is imperfect, but it over-reads the bounded maṣdar مسحًا introduced right after a fresh command in 38:33; (2) a thin lexical verb of 'applying oneself to / setting upon' rather than pure bleached aspect — which unifies 38:33's maṣdar more naturally. The packet cannot fully adjudicate inceptive vs. durative vs. light-lexical, so the invariant is stated conservatively as 'entry into and engagement with an externally-specified activity,' which all three tokens support.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: Three confirmed perfect-verb tokens: 20:121:6:2 (وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ), 7:22:9:2 (وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ), 38:33:3:2 (فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا) — each root segment at position :2 preceded by a proclitic conjunction (وَ/فَ), each governing an independent activity-expression and no object of its own.
layer_attribution.derivation: No derivational signal to reason from: qac_verb_form is null for all tokens (the 'V' in form_inventory is the POS tag 'Verb', not verb-form V); the root is a defective/frozen lexeme attested only in the perfect with no imperfect, imperative, participle, maṣdar, nominal, or derived form.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: A single lexicalized class — one monofunctional inceptive/ingressive verb 'set about / began (to do)' — content-empty, result-neutral, morally neutral; not a set of unbridged senses, hence LEXICALIZED_CLASS rather than UNRESOLVED_CLASS_ONLY.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Contextually the begun activities are stitching leaves in shame (Adam/Eve, 7:22/20:121) and wiping horses' legs and necks (Solomon, 38:33); these narrative specifics belong to the complements (خصف, مسح) and the surrounding verses, NOT to طفق, and are excluded from the root claim.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: 38:33 was preliminarily flagged RESISTANT for its maṣdar construction but reconciled to CONSISTENT as an adversarial boundary: the inceptive sense survives the variant frame, so it caps grading (MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE) without splitting the class or forcing UNRESOLVED.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: No persisting semantic resistance: all three occurrences are consistent with the inceptive nucleus. rejection_condition.challenging_finding: An occurrence (or a decisive re-parse of an existing one) in which طفق itself carries concrete lexical action-content, an object of its own, completion/result, moral valence, or non-perfective/derived morphology — i.e. طفق meaning a specific act (e.g. 'wipe/strike') with مسحًا read as its cognate object, rather than an empty inceptive governing a complement that supplies the action.
rejection_condition.search_location: The three confirmed tokens 20:121:6:2, 7:22:9:2, 38:33:3:2, especially the complement structure of 38:33 (مسحًا بالسوق والأعناق) and any future-discovered non-perfect or derived attestation of ط ف ق.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Test whether the activity-content and its objects hang off the complement (يخصفان / مسحًا) rather than off طفق, and whether the constant sense across the finite-verb and maṣdar complements is 'commenced/undertook'; check for any object governed directly by طفق or any reported completion of the act by طفق itself.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Do not treat 7:22 and 20:121 as two independent confirmations (they are one near-verbatim Adam context); do not import classical lexicon glosses of طفق; and separate the moral verbs of the Adam pericope (وعصى, فغوى) from طفق, which is aspectually neutral.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If طفق is shown to carry its own lexical/resultative/argument content, the content-empty inceptive nucleus is falsified and the root must be re-analyzed as a thin lexical verb (downgrading candidate_root_contribution and possibly the research_state).

reopen_conditions: If any Quranic occurrence of ط ف ق surfaces in a non-perfect form (imperfect, imperative, participle, maṣdar, or a derived form), reopen to test whether the frozen-perfect/aspectual-onset characterization still holds or whether the root carries independent lexical content.
